gaps.explanation: All funds agree with the p5 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds except Special Assessments. p12 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Special Assessments Fund (budgetary basis) prints Total resources actual 571,023 (Property 337,585, Intergovernmental 19,832, Special assessments 213,593, Interest 13); the p5 Special Assessments column prints Total revenues 646,040 (Property 337,838, Intergovernmental 19,832, Special assessments 288,357, Interest 13). Difference 646,040 - 571,023 = 75,017 (Special assessments 74,764 + Property 253) = gap. Other funds equal p5: General 2,921,669 (pp15-16), Street 2,271,965 (p11), EMS 880,991 (p13), Other Governmental Funds 11,799 (p14: 97 + 437 + 8,265 + 3,000). No detail fix.

Budgetary-basis schedules differ from the GAAP p5 columns: Street p11 Total charges to appropriations 2,264,390 vs p5 Street 2,212,655 (schedule over 51,735: public works 570,640 vs 591,409; capital outlay 221,595 vs 146,532; debt service 1,472,155 vs bond fees 31,115 + principal 1,415,089 + interest 28,510 = 1,474,714); Special Assessments p12 632,220 vs p5 643,296 (short 11,076: debt service 629,083 vs 598,500 + 41,659 = 640,159); EMS p13 1,578,732 vs p5 1,563,998 (over 14,734: public safety 1,402,608 vs 1,389,610; debt service 123,837 vs 113,530 + 8,571 = 122,101). -51,735 + 11,076 - 14,734 = -55,393 = gap.
